channel.title: Platform Roles on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Platform Roles on KubeSphere

item.title: Create Platform Roles
item.description: This section describes how to create a platform role. The KubeSphere platform provides the following built-in platform roles. You can also create roles to customize role permissions. Parameter Description platform-admin Platform administrator, who has all permissions on the KubeSphere platform, including platform role management, user management, cluster and workspace management, extension management, etc. platform-regular Platform regular user, who cannot access any resources before being invited to a workspace.

item.title: View Platform Role List
item.description: This section describes how to view the platform role list. Prerequisites You need to have the Role View permission on the KubeSphere platform. For more information, see Users and Platform Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Role View permissions. Click Users and Roles Management. In the left navigation pane, select Platform Roles. The platform role list provides the role’s name, description, and creation time.

item.title: View Platform Role Details
item.description: This section describes how to view platform role details. Prerequisites You need to have theRole Viewing permission on the KubeSphere platform. For more information, refer to Users and Platform Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Role Viewing permissions. ClickUser and Role Management. In the left navigation pane, select Platform Roles. In the platform roles list, click the name of a platform role to open its details page.

item.title: Edit Platform Role Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit platform role information. You can edit the alias and description of platform roles created by users. KubeSphere does not support editing built-in platform roles, nor does it support editing the names of platform roles. Prerequisites You need to have the Role Management permission on the KubeSphere platform. For more information, please refer to Users and Platform Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Role Management permissions.

item.title: Edit Platform Role Permissions
item.description: This section describes how to edit platform role permissions. You can only edit the permissions of user-created platform roles. The permissions of built-in platform roles cannot be edited. Prerequisites You need to have the Role Management permission on the KubeSphere platform. For more information, see Users and Platform Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Role Management permissions.

item.title: Delete Platform Roles
item.description: This section describes how to delete platform roles. You can delete platform roles created by users. Pre-configured platform roles cannot be deleted. Prerequisites You need to have the Role Management permission on the KubeSphere platform. For more information, refer to Users and Platform Roles. If the platform role you want to delete has already been assigned to users, you need to delete the users or modify their roles.
